stay.name: Casa Qafiz
stay.fromNote: including breakfast; double rooms from €250 to €350

packages.name: Qafiz First Taste Autunno
packages.includes: Welcome cocktail, couple’s massage, the ten-course tasting menu at Qafiz (drinks extra), a night in a double room, breakfast, a guided walk with a gourmet picnic

packages.name: Qafiz Olive Harvest
packages.includes: Welcome cocktail, couple’s massage, the ten-course tasting menu at Qafiz (drinks extra), a night in a double room, breakfast, olive picking, mill visit and a light lunch

packages.name: Qafiz Immersion Autunno
packages.includes: Welcome cocktail, couple’s massage, the ten-course tasting menu at Qafiz (drinks extra), dinner at the grill restaurant Ilici, two nights in a double room, breakfasts, a guided walk with picnic, olive picking and a mill visit

packages.name: Radici & Alta Cucina Light
packages.includes: Welcome cocktail, spa access with massage and pool, the ten-course tasting menu at Qafiz (drinks extra), dinner at Ilici, three nights in a double room, breakfasts, a day of art and sea visits, a picnic
packages.when: Wednesday to Friday; some activities May to October

stay.note: Casa Qafiz is a restored 1700s estate house with double rooms; guests must book rooms together with a table at Qafiz or Ilici, and children under 12 are not accepted.
